blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The official motto of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) is 'Industry, Impartiality and Integrity'.
The CBI was set up in 1963 via a resolution by the Ministry of Home Affairs.
The establishment of the CBI was recommended by the Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption (1962–1964).
CBI is not a statutory body; it derives its investigating powers from the Delhi Special Police Establishment (DSPE) Act, 1946.
Currently, the CBI functions under the administrative control of the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions.
